children: RB Global authorized a $500 million increase to its share repurchase program, raising total buyback capacity to $1 billion.
TSX approved NCIB amendment to allow repurchases up to the lesser of 14,224,129 shares and US$1 billion.
NCIB originally allowed up to 10,000,000 shares or US$500 million; program launched March 18, 2026.
As of Sept 11, 2026, RB Global repurchased 5,363,497 shares at an average price of ~$93.22 per share.
NCIB amendments expected effective Sept 17, 2026; program ends March 17, 2027 unless completed earlier.
